'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Vinayum Bari LS Yavin 4''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vinayum Bari]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name box blank. Facing-page pair with [[Vinayum Bari]] Dark You Can Run (p20), between [[Matt Sokol]] (p17–p18) and [[Greg Shaw]] (p21–p22). Deck name Obj.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
